name: Multiple Connections [Psionic]
body:
You are able to be attuned to multiple minds.

Prerequisite: Open Door, mindlock class feature.

Benefit: You can be attuned to up to three creatures for the purposes of Open Door.

Normal: You can only be attuned to one creature.
